collection.description: A child tries to follow a gust of wind across the beach.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) tries to follow a gust of wind across the beach.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a teacher, shows that wind is air moving from place to place.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) uses a ribbon to watch wind direction.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The ribbon tangles, and (child) tries a shorter one.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) shares a traditional tale without claiming proof.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) invents a playful name for the breeze.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) comes back puzzled and asks for a clearer explanation.
